## Standing operator rules
- “We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.”
- “All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name sms:delivery_attempt in the metrics label.”
- “Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.”
- “Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` sending reminders to customers who already paid.

Paused/superseded priorities: router splitting is paused; the `get_user_record` rename remains paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raising the SQLAlchemy pool size to 50: caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Removing pending events before persistence: broke failed-event retry retention.
- Aliasing the consumer incoming batch into `pending_events`: caused shared retained state.
- Using sandbox host `sbx-pay-a`: shut down and returns stale fixtures.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Remove worker batch aliasing, obsolete `_last_batch`, and pre-persistence event popping.
- [done] Verify workers: `pytest tests/workers -q` → exact result: `41 passed in 3.09s`.
- [done] Verify full suite: `pytest -q` → exact result: `118 passed, 7 skipped in 8.74s`.
- [done] Run memory repro: peak `7.3 MiB`, retained `2.1 MiB`, final pending count `0`.
- [done] Normalize CLI billing filters; `37 passed in 0.84s`; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.
- [status unknown] Added `test_billing_filter_abbreviations_parse`; test not yet run. Next exact command: `python -m pytest tests/test_cli.py tests/test_commands.py -q`
- [pending] Diagnose and fix paid-customer dunning reminders.
- [pending] Resume router split and remaining rename work later.

## Recent work
CLI shared billing filters now have one `--currency/-c`; command-layer assertions use `args.currency`. Added abbreviation regression coverage. No scheduler investigation has yet been performed.
